author: IGN
description:
Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen reviewed by Jarrett Green on PlayStation 5, also available on Xbox, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.

"Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen’s avalanche of new content is an icy salve for the burns left by a modern world full of incremental live-service updates. Trudging through the oppressive snowdrifts of this charming new region for dozens of hours felt like uncovering a past where games dropped meaty, activity-filled expansions all the time – fitting for a game so spiritually linked to a version of itself from 14 years ago. It's not all divine, as the campaign spends far too much of its final moments driving on repetitive tasks and its new Spoils slot machine makes the endgame gear hunt more lifeless than the frozen wastes you scrounge them from. But the journey, full of new and interesting characters, vibrant and violent enemies, and the wonderful wreckage of a bygone civilization, is an engrossing adventure worth the investment."
title: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Review

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
A leaker has suggested the price of just the RAM and storage for the PlayStation 6 could cost about as much as a PS5. The RAMpocalypse likely will not let up when the next generaiton of gaming consoles goes into production, with the leaker saying that the current PS6 configuration will likely cost $680 or more just for flash memory and RAM, which will very likely put the whole console's MSRP well aboe $1,000. And in other news, Quentin Tarantino has confirmed his plans to exit filmmaking after he completes his unannounced 10th film. But he has other plans before making that one, such as his upcoming West End play, The Pipinjay Cavalier starring Sacha Baron Cohen, and the follow-up to Once Upong a Time...In Hollywood that is directed by David Fincher. And and we’re heading back to How to Train Your Dragon’s Isle of Berk with the Ride Guys to soar through Hiccup’s Wing Gliders – all at Universal Orlando Resort.

#IGN #Gaming
title: PS6 RAM and Storage Alone Could Cost As Much As a PS5 - IGN Daily Fix

Set over the course of one explosive night, Best Pancakes in the County transforms an unassuming small-town diner into the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past and a waitress harboring secrets of her own. As loyalties blur and tensions erupt, survival depends on who can outthink — and outgun — everyone else.

Best Pancakes in the County stars Nicolas Cage, Justin Long, Lauren German, Brandon Mychal Smith, Shelley Hennig, Tetiana Dar, and more. The film is directed and written by Ken Sanzel. 

Best Pancakes in the County is in select theaters and on VOD on November 20.

author: IGN
description:
Have you ever wondered how every era of the Grand Theft Auto series could actually fit together? While Rockstar has always maintained the 2D, 3D, and HD continuities are completely separate, they can't help but fill each entry with callbacks, cameos, and easter eggs., and GTA 6 will be no different. So, we’ve built the ultimate unified timeline that blends them into one massive, interconnected American crime saga. We trace the epic story of the downfall of the Forrelli crime family, chart the the explosive rise of Tommy Vercetti in 1980s Vice City, CJ's return to Los Santos, Niko Bellic's disillusionment with the American Dream in a grimy Liberty City, and the chaotic, intertwining lives of Michael, Franklin, and Trevor in the San Andreas of GTA 5. Get ready to explore the betrayals, heists, and legendary crossovers that have defined decades of gaming history: perfectly setting the stage for Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval's upcoming rampage across the modern Vice City of GTA 6.
